## Evidence

## Checklist

- [ ] **Every added or changed line in `data/overrides/` carries a `src:` comment with a URL and the date checked.** No exceptions — the lint and the nightly build both reject unsourced lines.
- [ ] **`ruby scripts/lint_overrides.rb` passes locally** (stdlib only, no setup) and the `Lint data` check is green on this PR.
- [ ] Each line clears the **curation bar in its file's header** (`vpn_provider` = the ASN's primary business is a consumer VPN/anonymizer; `mobile_carrier` = dedicated cellular only; `enterprise_gateway` = SWG/SASE vendor egress only, not a company's own ASN; `cdn` = the brand's own ASN, not a same-name lookalike; `hosting_extra` = two curators agree, or one plus an evident hosting brand; `eyeball_confirm` = major consumer broadband/mobile ISP).
- [ ] Where the error is genuinely upstream's, it has **also been reported to [ipverse/as-metadata](https://github.com/ipverse/as-metadata)** (or the relevant upstream) — link the issue above.
- [ ] **`spotchecks.yml`: no bulk edits.** If any row changed, the description above says, per row, what changed in the world and how it was verified. Rows are a tripwire, never a target — adding rows is fine; rewriting them to make CI green is not.
- [ ] **`data/licenses/pins.json` is untouched.** Pins are regenerated by `rake licenses:pin` in the pipeline repo, in their own reviewed PR.
- [ ] No byte-layout change to the artifacts without a `format_version` bump, and no removal or rename in the verdict enum (append-only cross-language contract, D-IMPL-6).
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this content, and it is released as **CC0** (data) / **MIT** (scripts). It is my own conclusion from a public source, not a copy of someone else's database.
